title: Console: fix demo dashboard empty-state defaults (time range + seeded project selection)
author: Chloe Martin
release_notes: Console: Demo dashboards now default to a sensible time range and auto-select the seeded demo project to avoid confusing empty graphs during live demos.
description: Context: During live demos (and dry runs), the Console usage/cost/latency dashboards frequently opened to an empty state even though synthetic traffic was running. This was brittle and created awkward "click around until graphs show" moments. Root causes: (1) the dashboard route could resolve with no explicit time range and no persisted time range (fresh browser/profile, incognito, new SE laptop), which effectively resulted in a query window that returned nothing; (2) the seeded demo org has multiple projects and the dashboard page sometimes landed with no project selected (or a non-demo project selected), causing queries to return zero rows; (3) the empty-state UI did not explain what was wrong or provide a fast recovery path. Changes: Default time range behavior: If no time range is provided in URL query params and no persisted range exists, default dashboards to "Last 24 hours" (configurable constant; matches demo traffic generator distribution). This applies to the Overview, Cost Breakdown, Latency, and Errors views. Project selection behavior: When landing on a dashboard route without an explicit project_id, auto-select (a) the last selected project from localStorage when it is still accessible, else (b) the demo-seeded project if present (name match on "Demo - Core API" / internal seed tag), else (c) the most recently active project (based on last_event_at from project summary endpoint). Also fixed a race where the dashboard rendered before project list fetch completed and then never retried queries after selection resolved. Empty state UX: Replace the generic "No data" placeholder with an actionable empty state: explains likely causes (time range too narrow, wrong project, no recent events) and includes one-click actions: "Set to Last 24h" and "Select Demo Project" (when applicable). For internal users, the empty state also includes a small hint linking to the demo runbook section "Start synthetic traffic" (no direct job trigger from Console in this PR to keep scope tight). Telemetry: Added a lightweight event to track how often dashboards land in empty-state and how often auto-selection kicks in (console.dashboard_empty_state_shown, console.project_autoselect_applied) so we can confirm this addresses demo pain. Tests: Added Playwright coverage for the two common demo cases: fresh profile defaults to Last 24h and auto-selects demo-seeded project; and explicit project_id in deep link overrides auto-select. Also added a unit test for time range resolution precedence: URL param > persisted > default. Repro before: Open Console in an incognito window, navigate to Console → Observability → Cost for the demo org, note blank graphs with "No data" until manually switching time range and/or selecting the seeded project. After: Same steps show populated graphs with Last 24h and the correct project preselected; if there truly is no data, empty state provides clear recovery actions. Files/areas changed (high level): console-web/src/pages/observability/* (time range resolver + empty state); console-web/src/state/selectedProject.ts (project selection precedence + race fix); console-web/src/components/EmptyState/DashboardEmptyState.tsx (new component); console-web/src/telemetry/events.ts (new events); console-web/tests/playwright/observability-demo-defaults.spec.ts (new). Commits (summary): 1) "observability: add time range resolver w/ sane default" 2) "observability: fix project auto-selection + retry queries after selection" 3) "observability: improve empty-state messaging + actions" 4) "tests: add playwright coverage for demo dashboard defaults". Reviewer notes/resolutions: Dylan requested we avoid hard-coding a single demo project name; implemented seed tag fallback first, then name match as secondary. Logan asked to ensure telemetry is sampled and doesn’t include project names/ids in payload; event payload is boolean-only (has_project_param, used_seed_tag, used_local_storage) and respects existing sampling. Allison requested confirmation that changing defaults won’t mask real ingestion issues; added a small banner in empty state that still surfaces "No events received" when the backend explicitly reports no recent events. Leila requested the Playwright tests be resilient to slow CI; added wait-for project list fetch and increased timeout on the first data render assertion. CI: web-build, web-lint, web-test, playwright-smoke all green after one rerun (initial flake on playwright due to missing deterministic clock; fixed by freezing time in test). Rollout: No backend changes; safe to ship behind existing Console release. This PR is a prerequisite for stabilizing the demo tenant experience referenced in SUP-4189 and the synthetic traffic seeding work in ENG-4833.
